title: Formed collective (parallel composition ∥ of characters)
description: A collective formed out of characters by parallel composition (the monoidal product ∥ on arenas — the algebraic shape of scale relations between coordinated participants). A general collective with no governance and no coordinating office yet; swarm and ensemble are restricted formings (forming then restricting). Codomain of forming. participants are character personas/role-slugs (references).

participants.description: the composed characters, by persona or role-slug reference
